fact: The World Bank project paper says procurement of a GBV management information system, to be integrated with the GBV call center and possibly other programme MISs and the national Social Registry, is on-going under GEWEL 2.
Zambia's MCDSS Permanent Secretary says 92 percent of Social Cash Transfer beneficiary households now receive transfers through mobile money or bank accounts.
Zambia's government reported its Social Cash Transfer digitised, with one million beneficiaries onboarded onto mobile money platforms.
